Payslip Items

Reporting categories for payslip items allow you to classify different types of employee payments and deductions for comprehensive financial reporting and analysis.

When you set up payslip items (such as wages, overtime, bonuses, tax withholdings, or retirement contributions), you can assign each item to a specific reporting category. This categorization helps you track where payroll expenses are allocated in your financial statements.

Benefits of Using Reporting Categories

By assigning reporting categories to payslip items, you can generate detailed reports that show total amounts for each category across all employees and pay periods. This provides valuable insights into your overall payroll structure and helps with budgeting and cost analysis.

For example, you might have separate reporting categories for regular wages, overtime pay, bonuses, payroll taxes, and employee benefits. This allows you to see at a glance how much you're spending in each area.

Setting Up Categories

To configure reporting categories for your payslip items, click the New Reporting Category button. Give each category a descriptive name that clearly indicates what types of payslip items it will contain.

Once you've created your reporting categories, you can assign them to individual payslip items when setting up or editing those items. Each payslip item can only belong to one reporting category.
